annotations.title: Refresh an MCP server's tool list

description: Snapshot the bound server's current tools (with their readOnlyHint / destructiveHint annotations) for approval. Approvals of tools that no longer exist are dropped. The binding must be ready; a server inside the sandbox has no gateway tool list. Requires config:write.

serverName.description: Server name as the repository's MCP file declares it (see list_mcp_servers)

name: refresh_mcp_server_tools
